import json
base='tests/php_oracle/manifests/streams/php-8.5.6/%s/streams-full.json'
T=['macos-aarch64','linux-x86_64','linux-aarch64']
tab={}
for t in T:
    c=json.load(open(base%t))['surface']['constants']
    if isinstance(c,list):
        c={e['name']:e.get('value') for e in c}
    tab[t]=c
names=[n for n in tab['macos-aarch64'] if n.startswith('GLOB_')]
names+= [n for n in ('SEEK_SET','LOCK_EX','PHP_INT_SIZE','DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR') if n in tab['macos-aarch64']]
print(f'{"name":<26}'+''.join(f'{t:>16}' for t in T))
for n in sorted(set(names)):
    row=[tab[t].get(n,'—') for t in T]
    d='' if len(set(map(str,row)))==1 else '  <-- DIFFERS'
    print(f'{n:<26}'+''.join(f'{str(v):>16}' for v in row)+d)
print()
print('total constants:', {t:len(tab[t]) for t in T})
